_comment: Calibration of the reference image 05293190AC: names, descriptions and units of tables and constants (address in bank 0, hex). Units are defined in docs/en/calibration.md. Tables not listed here are still found and laid out by tools/caltables.py; they get generated names (Tab2D_xxxx ...). Sources: 2GNT calibration page for 05293190AC and the code.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table

08F8.name: PartThrottleMapScale
08F8.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0904.name: WotMapScale
0904.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

0BF6.name: PartThrottleFuel
0BF6.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0F6C.name: WotFuel
0F6C.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0B76.name: InjectorDeadTime
0B76.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

0B9E.name: ReturnlessFuelScale
0B9E.desc: Global fuel multiplier of the returnless fuel system

24AB.name: KnockThreshold
24AB.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

2684.name: IdleTargetRpm
2684.desc: Target idle speed against coolant temperature

0B92.name: PartThrottleFuelK
0B92.desc: K factor of the part-throttle base pulse width: (MAP - offset) * (256 + K) / 16

0B93.name: PartThrottleFuelMapOffset
0B93.desc: MAP offset of the part-throttle base pulse width

0B94.name: WotFuelK
0B94.desc: K factor of the WOT base pulse width

0B95.name: WotFuelMapOffset
0B95.desc: MAP offset of the WOT base pulse width

19DB.name: RevLimitResume
19DB.desc: Rev limiter (manual transmission / park-neutral): fuel back on below

19DC.name: RevLimit
19DC.desc: Rev limiter (manual transmission / park-neutral): fuel cut above

4052.name: FaultTable
4052.desc: Fault attributes: id, trigger count, blink code, attributes, bit mask, byte offset, P-code (BCD), 2 spare bytes
